enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Lie on back. Stretch arms. Stretch legs. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply face wash. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Pour eggs. Stir eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Take toast from toaster. Place toast on plate. Put eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing a work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Put on shirt. Take out pants. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to office building. Enter office building. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs and answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Enter office. Walk to desk. Sit on chair. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open email program. Read emails. Reply to emails. Pick up phone. Make call. Write notes. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Stand up. Walk to meeting room. Sit in meeting. Discuss program. Take notes. Walk back to desk. Continue typing.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from desk. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch box. Close refrigerator. Open microwave. Place lunch box inside. Close microwave. Press start button. Wait. Microwave beeps. Open microwave. Take out lunch box. Close microwave. Walk to table. Sit down. Open lunch box. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Close lunch box. Stand up. Throw away trash. Walk back to desk. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, running program logistics and meeting with community partners
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on computer. Open program logistics spreadsheet. Update data. Make phone calls to partners. Send emails. Walk to meeting room. Meet with partners. Shake hands. Discuss logistics. Take notes. Walk back to desk. Print documents. Organize files. Stand up. Walk to colleague's desk. Discuss program. Walk back to desk. Sit down. Continue typing.
Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Wait. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Pour oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add salt. Turn off cooker. Take plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and cleaning up the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply dish soap. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place plate in dish rack. Wash mug. Rinse mug. Place in rack. Wash utensils. Rinse. Place in rack. Turn off tap. Pick up cloth. Wipe counter. Wipe stove. Turn off light.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button. TV turns on. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get water. Walk back. Sit down. Continue watching. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing program notes and planning tomorrow on the computer with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Enter password. Open program notes. Read notes. Type notes. Open calendar. Plan tomorrow. Write schedule. Check email. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bed. Sit on bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Use toilet. Wash hands. Walk back to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Lie on back. Stretch arms. Stretch legs. Remain asleep.
